summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. to disclose an oral presentation and two poster presentations at the AACR Annual Meeting 2026. The filings under Items 7.01 and 8.01 provide updates on preclinical research, including the TNX-1700 program and anti-BTLA monoclonal antibodies. No transaction, strategic review, or special situation is involved. The information is furnished for regulatory compliance and is not deemed filed under the Exchange Act. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. This is a standard current report of scientific developments, not a special situation.
